attempt_summaries.rationale: Added automountServiceAccountToken false, set runAsUser/fsGroup to 999 and runAsNonRoot true, set allowPrivilegeEscalation false, added readOnlyRootFilesystem true with emptyDir mounts for /var/run/postgresql and /tmp, added CPU/Memory limits and requests meeting minimum memory.

final_yaml:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: orders-db
  namespace: data
spec:
  serviceName: orders-db
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: orders-db
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: orders-db
    spec:
      securityContext:
        fsGroup: 999
        runAsUser: 999
        runAsNonRoot: true
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: postgres:15.6
          args: ["-c", "shared_buffers=256MB"]
          env:
            - name: PGDATA
              value: /var/lib/postgresql/data/pgdata
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: orders-db
                  key: password
          ports:
            - name: pg
              containerPort: 5432
          volumeMounts:
            - name: pgdata
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
            - name: var-run-postgresql
              mountPath: /var/run/postgresql
            - name: tmp
              mountPath: /tmp
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
          resources:
            limits:
              cpu: "500m"
              memory: "512Mi"
            requests:
              cpu: "250m"
              memory: "256Mi"
      volumes:
        - name: var-run-postgresql
          emptyDir: {}
        - name: tmp
          emptyDir: {}
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: pgdata
      spec:
        accessModes: ["ReadWriteOnce"]
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: 20Gi
